TC-APT-036.title: Safe placeholder scheme for STRONG/LINK so full-sentence extraction can include bold/link content without losing translatability
TC-APT-036.note: LINK half LANDED and VALIDATED ON REAL CONTENT (2ddeeb3). TC-APT-075.title: Structural: a page whose candidates were review-rejected can never be regenerated in the live tree. A fresh campaign id refuses because pre-existing untracked outputs are unreceipted (campaign_manifest.py:432, allow_existing_accepted comes only from the campaign's OWN ledger), and resuming the original id re-gates the existing bytes rather than re-translating (campaign_runner.py:405 on config_fingerprint advance). The only tree-cleaning move is deleting content, which is barred. Hit on 2 pages now (introducing-cells-foss-go 17 files, words-document-net 11), so it is structural, not incidental. Needs an operator-reviewed mechanism -- candidate: subtract declared replace_existing paths in the campaign_scoped branch as the sibling branch at campaign_manifest.py:393 already does, IF that asymmetry is an oversight. RESOLVED by a peer session in 5ee0fd3: the require_clean/campaign_scoped branch now subtracts set(declared), matching line ~393. Two tests pin both directions -- a declared+dirty target no longer blocks, an UNDECLARED dirty output still does -- and _run_campaign_job's per-job 'declared replacement pre-hash drift' check is untouched as the real safety net. tests/unit/workers: 605 passed, 1 skipped.

TC-APT-076.title: A paragraph containing a link is still leaf-split, because _has_technical_content (text_unit_extractor.py:2171-2173) returns True for any LINK child -- a second gate independent of _has_inline_formatting, which TC-APT-036 fixed. Measured on words-document-net: 15 paragraphs, 12 whole, 3 split, all 3 by technical-content alone, 0 by formatting. The model receives fragments (a dangling subordinator, a context-free anchor, a subjectless verb phrase) instead of sentences, which is consistent with the A1 determiner-binding and A2 head-noun review failures. Fix is a one-line deletion but changes segmentation portfolio-wide; needs the TC-APT-042 byte-identical render-neutrality proof before it is trusted.
